name: testcafe-tutorial
description: TestCafe page-object patterns, React selectors, and axe accessibility checks.

scripts.test: npm run test:local && npm run test:the-internet
scripts.test:local: npm run test:unit && npm run test:react
scripts.test:react: npm run build:fixture && testcafe chrome:headless reactSelectors/tests/*.js --app "node fixtures/serve.mjs"
scripts.test:live: npm run build:fixture && testcafe chrome reactSelectors/tests/*.js -L --app "node fixtures/serve.mjs"
